parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes, each using a different type of pastry. At least
one of the dishes must be savoury.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using pasta and a batch of biscuits using the melting method.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two friends who are trying to lose weight.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a cake using the creaming method and a batch of scones.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve four skilful dishes, each to show the use of a different piece of
equipment from the following list:
grater, grill, rolling pin, steamer, wooden spoon.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a batch of small cakes or a tray bake.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal that is high in non-starch polysaccharide
(NSP) / dietary fibre.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a savoury dish using a coating batter and a cake using the whisking method.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes, each to show the use of a different ingredient from the
cheese, chocolate, fish, lemon, rice, a root vegetable, wholemeal flour.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two foreign visitors who wish to sample
local food.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a savoury dish using a fruit and a batch of biscuits using the rubbing-in method.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes suitable for serving cold at your end-of-term party. At
least two of the dishes must be savoury. One of the dishes must be a decorated cake.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal that is rich in calcium for two young children.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make two sweet or savoury baked dishes that these children could share with their family.
